updates.text: Added daily posting schedule at 9 am Malaysia time, three content options (work, news, meme), and private‑repo support with meme captions as punchlines.
Implemented health monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and an operator dashboard with weather, storm detour, and fleet map features.
Tick the market every 10 minutes from GitHub Actions.
Added a knife‑edge flight script with rotor‑aware roll controller, disturbances for robustness, and a Blender animation rendering the Gannet.

Started daily-post-bot: a Python bot that reads GitHub activity, fetches Hacker News stories, and uses a Groq model to generate LinkedIn and X posts in a user‑defined voice, then posts via GitHub Actions or manual triggers.
Started slipstream: browser-based flight simulator for a morphing quadrotor, integrating physics, autopilot, SPICE power models, and rendering tools.
Started tiny-gpu: a Verilog GPU for an iCE40UP5K FPGA that rasterises triangles into a 64×64 framebuffer and drives a 640×480 VGA display via USB.
Implemented a GPU core with clear, triangle, and present functions, added a triangle rasteriser with a 64×64 framebuffer, and enabled 640×480 VGA output scaled 7×.
